dispute.claim_text: Friday evening Bugis to Jurong East. The app said 18 km. He took me up the PIE past Adam Road and all the way round, 24 km, and I got hit with 1.6x surge on top of the extra distance plus $4.50 of ERP. $58.10 for a trip I normally pay $40 for on a Friday. The surge I accept. The extra 6 km I do not.

counterparty_statement.text: AYE was crawling from the Alexandra exit so I went up and over on the PIE. Longer on the map but it moved. No advisory that I know of.

admissibility.notes: Trip record complete and causally ordered. optimal_route_erp_sgd of 2.50 records that the optimal route crosses the Kim Keat Link gantry and nothing else, which is what makes the gantry set MIXED rather than wholly off-route.

dropoff.label: Jurong East MRT (Exit B), 10 Jurong Gateway Rd

payload.optimal_route_source: routing-engine-v3.2 (LTA traffic snapshot 18:36; optimal is PIE westbound via Kim Keat Link, crossing that gantry only)

admissibility.notes: Unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage. The trace passes within 250 m of both billed gantries, so neither is a phantom line under POL-RD-09(4).
Rider query and driver reply, both delivered and read. The reply asserts congestion and cites no advisory.

messages.text: adam road?? jurong is the other way
AYE jam boss, this way faster

admissibility.notes: Line items reconcile to the cent, including a surge_amount of 19.80 which is 0.60 of the 33.00 surgeable subtotal. Note that surge is applied to base, distance and time only and NOT to the 4.50 of ERP.

issue_details.detail: No LTA advisory covers the AYE, the PIE or the Alexandra corridor in the 18:36-19:20 window on 7 August 2026. The driver's congestion claim names no artifact.

admissibility.notes: Artifact absent. The identifier is minted anyway so that the absence itself can be cited by either advocate.
